subject: Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: HireBridge Recruiting <sarah.li@hirebridge.co>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: [Action] Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires

Hi all,

We need a quick approval path to onboard three hires for the GPU runtime team to meet the Q3 throughput and kernel latency workstreams: two Senior Runtime Engineers (expected L5/L6 split) and one Kernel SRE (L5). Hiring timeline is tight — ramp has to start mid-April to hit delivery milestones.

Why now:
- Customer commitments tied to throughput improvements active in Q3.
- Current contractor support for kernel work is reaching a hard stop end of June.
- Risk to SLAs if we defer (higher support load + slower iteration on quantization kernels).

Proposal (high level):
- Roles: 2x Senior Runtime Engineers (one L6, one L5), 1x Kernel SRE (L5).
- Target bands (total cash + equity headline): see attached Offer_Bands_2028.pdf.
- Delegation ask: allow recruiter to extend verbal offers up to the band midpoint for L5 and up to midpoint + 10% for L6 without exec co-sign, with a formal signed offer requiring payroll/finance codes and legal review.
- Budget: HC_Budget_Q2_2028.xlsx attached (GL: INF-OP-3.2).

Immediate asks:
1) Approve headcount and delegation authority so HireBridge can move fast on verbal offers.
2) Confirm whether we convert the incumbent contractor (Contract Talent LLC) directly for the Kernel SRE or open a full search.
3) Marcus, can you confirm onboarding capacity in April/May?

If we can close delegation today, Sarah has two candidates in final stage and can verbal-offer tomorrow.

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Director, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 20:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [Action] Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires

Naomi — thanks for the write-up. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I can sign off on delegated authority:

- Can you send a 12-month TCO (salary + benefits + recruiting + ramp overlap for contractor) breakdown per role? I want to see the delta between two seniors vs 1 senior + 2 mid-levels.
- If we allow verbal offers to midpoint +10% for L6, what controls are we putting in place to prevent escalation requests later? (I.e., documented band reasoning, final offer approval checkbox by finance).
- For contractor conversion: what is the net cash delta vs hiring a direct FTE (including notice/offsets)?

If we can get the TCO table and a quick redline of the delegation wording in Delegation_Rationale_20280301.docx I'll review and can approve delegated authority up to the ranges you propose.

Kimberly
VP, Talent & Total Rewards
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: HireBridge Recruiting <sarah.li@hirebridge.co>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [Action] Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires

Thanks Naomi — operationally we can support two hires starting in mid-April if offers are verbalized this week and final paperwork completed by mid-April. A couple of options to consider to reduce near-term cost while preserving velocity:

Option A (faster, higher skill):
- 1x L6 Senior Runtime Engineer (focus: kernel optimizations)
- 1x L5 Senior Runtime Engineer (focus: batching/serving reliability)
- 1x L5 Kernel SRE (convert contractor)
Estimated 12-month incremental cash: ~ $620k (salaries + benefits + recruiting).

Option B (cost-smoothing):
- 1x L6 Senior + 2x Mid-level Runtime Engineers (L4) — moves some execution to less expensive hires and keeps senior design ownership with L6.
Estimated 12-month incremental cash: ~ $480k.

If Talent approves delegation to midpoint +10% for L6, I suggest we still hold firm on equity bands and include a mandatory recruiter note in the ATS explaining the competitive reason for above-midpoint offers.

I'll block calendar for onboarding planning once we have firm accepts.

Marcus
Head of Platform Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 15:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [Action] Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires

Looping in compensation/legal notes:

- We cannot sign offers that exceed the published band cap without exec sign-off. Delegation to midpoint +10% is permissible for verbal offers provided the following are attached to the ATS entry: rationale memo, signed hiring manager attestation, and finance GL confirmation.
- Equity: any offer that changes the equity baseline for the role (e.g., promoting early or above-benchband grants) requires a separate equity approval and must be routed to EquityOps.
- Relocation/visa: if candidate requires relocation stipend or H1B sponsorship, do not verb/extend without explicit confirmation from Immigration & Ops.

I have uploaded a short Delegation_Rationale template (attached) and can approve the delegation language below: 

"Hiring manager and Talent may extend verbal offers up to midpoint (L5) and midpoint +10% (L6). Any final signed offer exceeding band cap requires exec sign-off. All verbal offers must be recorded in the ATS with rationale and finance code prior to start-of-onboarding."

If you want DocuSign-ready language, use the DocuSign link in related_links and we'll get legal to stamp it.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Employment & Compensation
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Mar 2028 18:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [Action] Offer structure and headcount delegation for GPU runtime hires

Approving the headcount (3 roles) and the following delegation, contingent on the attachments/controls Marissa outlined being present in the ATS and finance confirming GL INF-OP-3.2:

- Delegated authority to extend verbal offers up to band midpoint for L5.
- Delegated authority to extend verbal offers up to midpoint +10% for L6.
- Any candidate requiring relocation/immigration support or any final signed offer above published band cap must be elevated to me for sign-off.

Naomi: proceed with HireBridge for verbal offers tomorrow. Kimberly/Marissa: please confirm by EOD that the TCO and delegation wording are in the drive link and GC/legal have visibility. Marcus: coordinate onboarding slate and let me know if we need to push any delivery dates.

Thanks — Hannah
VP, Engineering Operations
